title: vaporize app mode silently ran swift build against non-SPM xcodeproj apps
createdBy: Claude/Opus 4.8 — found live trying to open the collective mac app via 'vaporize --artifact app --package-path <app> run'.
description:
REPRO: 'vaporize.cli@wrkstrm-core.clia.sh --artifact app --package-path --product

run' with no --xcode-project/--xcode-workspace flags. EXPECTED: build the .xcodeproj app via xcodebuild. ACTUAL: SwiftAppInstaller.buildApp() routed to 'xcrun swift build --package-path --build-system xcode' because request.hasXcodeBuildConfiguration was false, then failed with the misleading 'Could not find Package.swift in this directory or any of its parent directories' — an SPM red herring that hid the real (xcodebuild) build path entirely. This is the tooling-silent-fallback-to-wrong-state-not-error-loud failure mode: app mode assumed SPM and fell through to the wrong builder instead of detecting the project shape or failing loud. FIX: main.swift resolvedXcodeAppInputs(packagePath:product:) normalizes app-mode inputs before constructing the SwiftAppInstaller.Request: explicit --xcode-project/--xcode-workspace win untouched; a real Swift package (Package.swift present) keeps the swift build path; otherwise the path is treated as an Xcode-project app and a unique .xcworkspace (preferred) or .xcodeproj is discovered with the scheme defaulting to the product name (so the no-flags invocation Just Works); if the path is neither a Swift package nor a unique Xcode project/workspace it throws a loud ValidationError instead of invoking swift build. The routing decision is factored into the filesystem-free XcodeAppInputResolver (in swift-app-installer) so it is unit-testable; main.swift gathers the FileManager facts and delegates. PROVING GROUND: Tests/cuj-02-mac-app/VaporizeCUJ02XcodeAppInputResolverTests.swift sweeps the option space (Package.swift→SwiftPM, explicit-flags-win, single .xcodeproj→xcode scheme=product, workspace-preferred-over-project, explicit-scheme-override, multi-project disambiguate-by-product, neither→throws, ambiguous→throws, error-message-reports-counts) — 10 cases, all green (swift test --filter VaporizeCUJ02: 29/29). VERIFIED end-to-end: fresh debug binary routes the collective app to 'xcodebuild -project collective.xcodeproj -scheme collective ... build' and, on an empty dir, fails loud ('is not a Swift package (no Package.swift) and no unique .xcodeproj/.xcworkspace was found'). Downstream note: xcodebuild then surfaced the collective app's OWN pre-existing blocker (project.yml + CollectiveRootView.swift reference SpawnSoftware2DViz + WrkstrmVisualizationKit, both archived to legacy-profiles/wrkstrm-app) — a separate dangling-rehome bug, not vaporize's. Confirming instance of [[tooling-silent-fallback-to-wrong-state-not-error-loud]].
